en: A vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a prominent tall monument with a female figure holding three stars at the top. The monument is situated in the center of a wide square, surrounded by streets and trees. Several figures and buildings can be seen in the background, including a spired structure. The postcard has a decorative border and text in both German and Latvian at the bottom.
